reviews.text: A huge thank you to Dr. Noeuvéglise and the entire veterinary assistant team for their conscientious and compassionate care of our cat, Olive. Dr. Noeuvéglise is very attentive and meticulous with her patients, but also patient and kind. We feel completely confident, and the team is always available to answer our questions and address our concerns.
This is my absolute favourite restaurant in Paris. They are very kind. The service is excellent and the food oh my God, especially the liver and the steak tartar.

10/10... to Dr. Rivière for the excellent emergency care my cat received, which was a necessary correction for negligence by my regular vet.

Dear Madam, you have the skills and the love for animals.

I only read excellent reviews, and you were recommended to me by my sister, whose cat you treat.

Despite my cat's deplorable condition today, I know he is in good hands. You reassured me and conducted a thorough examination.
I give you 20/20, not 5 stars, but a thousand stars!

Excellent experience at the Montgallet veterinary clinic.

The welcome was very warm. The veterinarian was very patient and helpful, taking all the time necessary to give us excellent advice for our kitten's health and well-being. Caring and professional care; I highly recommend them!

Finding veterinarians who aren't in it solely for the money is unfortunately becoming increasingly rare.

This clinic is the only one that, despite a very busy schedule, agreed to see me as an emergency after I found an abandoned one-month-old kitten, whom I subsequently adopted.

A huge thank you to the entire team for your professionalism, kindness, and responsiveness.

Doudou and I now know who to turn to.
Veterinarians who take the time and understand the animal's needs. The best vet.

I highly recommend this wonderful team who take excellent care of our babies (cats and dogs). They are very clean and welcoming.
Thank you all!
Viviane

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Dr. Rivière has been treating my dogs for several years, and I highly recommend her! She is incredibly kind to animals, a great listener, and always explains things clearly. When I lost my first dog, she showed immense compassion and professionalism. When I adopted Jackie, it was a no-brainer for me to go back to her, even though I no longer live in the neighborhood.

A huge thank you also to the entire veterinary assistant team, who are always welcoming, available, and lovely. It's a clinic where you feel confident and where your companions are in very good hands. 🐾💛

Little Vagabond absolutely loved the treat, thank you so much!
I'm wondering if he'll be even more easily persuaded to come next time 😸 …

Hello,
We have just lost our second pet (a 17-year-old cat).

We would like to thank the entire team at the MONTGALLET Veterinary Clinic, and especially Dr. Juliette NOEUVEGLISE, who cared for our dog Moon until he was 17 and our little Chamallow until she was 17 and a half.
If our animals reached such remarkable longevity, it is thanks to the professionalism and expertise of the Veterinary Clinic.
A big thank you to the veterinarians and also to the veterinary nurses.
Best wishes.
Marie-Claire and Nghien
Kindness and competence.
I've been going there for two years now, and it's always been perfect. The vets are very friendly, approachable, and good at explaining things. No extra charges or surcharges, it's really great!
Very pleasant staff who take the time to explain things thoroughly. Fair prices. I recommend them.
Excellent clinic that has always taken great care of several of our animals. A special thank you for taking such good care of our dear old girl, Vanille!
We highly recommend this clinic. Our little companions have always been cared for there with great professionalism and gentleness.

The three veterinarians at this practice are exceptionally gentle, and the veterinary assistants are very pleasant and offer excellent advice. We always feel confident when we bring our pets to this clinic.

We are delighted to have such wonderful professionals for our little cats 🐈
Thank you for everything you've done for Hilda 💜 …

First time at this vet and pleasantly surprised by the friendly welcome and the professionalism of the clinic. The vet took excellent care of my cat and you can tell she loves animals. I highly recommend them, especially since the price of the booster vaccination isn't excessive 👍 …
I loved it, it was funny. They announced it in such a way that we wouldn't be sad.

Fantastic vets! I had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Rivière and Dr. David, and they were wonderful with my cat! They work closely with the rescue organization where I adopted him, which adds to their credit.
Not professional. Overcharging for every treatment

My 17-year-old cat has been a patient at this clinic for a few years now, and I highly recommend the veterinarians who work there. Their passion, love for animals, patience, and kindness towards both owners and animals are invaluable! A special shout-out to Dr. Rivière, whom my Doodoo adores ;)

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. I took my 15-year-old dog there for the first time two years ago and was impressed by Willy's reaction; he didn't tremble under stress. Two years later, no longer living in Paris, I made the trip from Barcelona for Willy's annual check-up. Empathetic, professional…

I am deeply grateful to Dr. Rivière and the entire clinic team for their expert and compassionate care of my cat at the end of his life. When he was no longer treatable or transportable, Dr. Rivière assured me that everything would be done to ensure his comfort, which was incredibly reassuring. Indeed, I received advice by phone and email, and was prescribed pain medication. My beloved cat passed away peacefully in his sleep, surrounded by me. The assistants and veterinarians also provided me with kindness and checked in on him regularly. A very big thank you.

I love this vet office in Paris. I have now had my cat Uki seen by all 3 of the vets, and they all treat him with the best care. The assistants are super kind and helpful as well. I highly recommend!!
A fantastic experience with Dr. David and Dr. Noeuveglise, who were incredibly attentive to our two cats. They love animals, and it shows in their work. I highly recommend them!
A very good veterinary clinic with a fantastic team and very reasonable fees, offering exceptional care, unlike other veterinary clinics such as the one in Gentilly, which I do not recommend at all.
The veterinary assistants and Dr. Rivière are rare veterinarians who are both passionate and compassionate! Highly competent. Thank you for your care ❤️

The staff at the clinic provided a very warm welcome and excellent advice. I dealt with several of the vets there and had no complaints. The only downside was the waiting room, which is sometimes too small when dogs are present; the close quarters can be difficult to manage, especially if the dogs aren't fond of cats. 🐱 …

An excellent clinic where the veterinarians and veterinary assistants practice their profession with passion, kindness, and professionalism. The well-being and health of our four-legged companions are their top priority. My cat Romeo has always received excellent care there, despite being aggressive and therefore very difficult to manage. My cat Grenadine has been a patient at this clinic since she was a kitten, and she's a big fan of Dr. Rivière.

This small practice, portrayed as friendly and independent, prioritizes charging over 50 euros for consultations, regardless of the animal's condition, even before its mission of caring for and helping animals. It's a shame to claim independence while maintaining such a purely financial relationship with patients.
A lovely and attentive team. A huge thank you! ❤️

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. Warm welcome, quick and efficient care!
My cat was experiencing repeated vomiting. X-rays and an ultrasound were performed, a foreign body was identified in his intestine, and surgery was performed immediately.
I was able to pick him up the next day after observation.
They kept me informed throughout the entire process, including providing me with a quote.
The prices are very reasonable and much lower than at other clinics. For a similar procedure, I paid more than three times this price in Meaux… Thank you again for the care given to my cat 🙏🥰

Hello and thank you for your kind feedback. It warms our hearts, especially since we know you're familiar with our profession. We pride ourselves on maintaining a positive and cheerful atmosphere within the team! Thank you so much, and see you very soon! Kisses to the two darlings!

For the past eight years, I've been coming at least twice a year for checkups for my rabbits, Sauerkraut and Seagull. I live in the 77 (Seine-et-Marne department), and I only trust this clinic.
I'm writing today because I witnessed some truly shocking behavior from an owner in the waiting room. This person clearly lacked empathy and patience when faced with a delayed appointment.
This kind of childish behavior is beyond me. All my support to the veterinarians at the clinic!

Yes, there are sometimes delays, but our animals are living beings, and we should be grateful that veterinarians spend so much time with them, ensuring their well-being, and that they don't rush through consultations just to increase their productivity!
They sometimes see several consultations back-to-back, patiently and without a break, often without taking time for themselves! I truly commend these veterinarians and their assistants, whom I highly recommend. They were there for me during difficult times (mentally, when I was worried, and sometimes financially). My animals adore them and feel completely at ease in the treatment room because they are so gentle and kind. I always get answers to my questions, and I've never seen them be upset. They never leave room for doubt and go the extra mile to find the right treatment.

I work in the service industry, and I know how hard it is to deal with people all day while maintaining professionalism and a positive attitude.
So, to that owner who didn't even greet the veterinarian and had the nerve to say, "That doesn't make me want to come back," please don't come back. No one needs your contemptuous attitude.
Dr. Natty David is very kind and approachable! I highly recommend him.

Only caring and competent vets.
I won't be changing clinics anytime soon.
The vets are very gentle and caring with our furry friends!
As a foster family for dogs, I've only had positive experiences with this clinic. I highly recommend Dr. David, who is always available, attentive, competent, and takes excellent care of the dogs!
The staff were very friendly and professional; I loved bringing my cat there. Plus, the prices are very competitive.
Friendly, available, and attentive 👍👍👍👍 …

Absolutely fantastic team. Everyone is lovely.
Dr. Rivière was recommended to me, and I understand why. A super friendly vet who loves our little animals. He'll be my vet from now on.

Thank you.
